name: Ootsuka
source:
Blessed with an amazing physique, she used to be a judoka who won a national championship and was on her way to a promising career.

After retiring due to an injury, she spent her days in a state of depression, but when Amamiya invited her to join her, she decided to pursue his career as her assistant.

[From [url=https://nexton-net.jp/ms-toybox/darkone/sakuseibyoto3/character/index.html]official site[/url]]
